P01.rationale: A large portrait of a founder/worker dominates the right side of the page, serving as the primary visual anchor.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies or client portraits on this page; it is a summary/conclusion section.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus such as logos, ratings, or review grids is present.

P10.rationale: The headline 'Die Konsequenz' uses oversized decorative typography that dominates the upper section of the layout.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualizations are present in the form of specific metrics (e.g., '2.3-fache erhöht') and a QR code representing digital proof.

P12.rationale: The page is dense with text blocks and imagery, filling the sheet without appearing sparse or under-filled.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is created by a darkened construction site photo that provides depth to the layout.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed background photo is treated with significant darkening (scrim) so that all overlaid text remains perfectly readable.

P16.rationale: A device mockup is shown as the subject holds a smartphone in his hand, adding product credibility to the scene.

N07.rationale: The imagery depicts a specific construction worker and site rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with text columns and visual elements.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a darkened background rather than a busy photo without scrim, ensuring high readability.
